name: MEGA
description: Resolves MEGA file links and files of the signed-in account, and describes how the host decrypts their bytes.

codes.mega.access_denied: This MEGA file needs an account that may see it
codes.mega.account_key_foreign: This file reached the MEGA account through a share, which this plugin cannot open yet
codes.mega.account_node_missing: This file is no longer in the MEGA account
codes.mega.attributes_unreadable: This MEGA link's key does not open this file
codes.mega.key_invalid: This MEGA link carries no usable decryption key
codes.mega.node_missing: This file is no longer in the MEGA folder it was found in
codes.mega.not_found: This MEGA file no longer exists or never did
codes.mega.not_mine: This is not a MEGA file address
codes.mega.quota_exceeded: MEGA's transfer quota for this address is used up
codes.mega.rate_limited: MEGA is rate limiting requests from this address
codes.mega.session_required: This MEGA file is only reachable while signed in
codes.mega.unavailable: MEGA is temporarily not answering for this file
